title: Master Development Prompt v3.1 Yellow
body:
<!-- DOCX is authoritative for yellow highlighting and page layout. -->

# DUDOS Master Development Prompt

Version 3.1 Yellow Review Candidate | 15 September 2026

Use this complete prompt with the DUDOS Master Constitution v3.0, its retained v2.1 package, the v3.0 control register, selected template bodies and project evidence. It directs a team or coding agent to produce an implemented, tested vertical slice and expand through controlled modules. A prompt run must report what it actually built, tested and connected.

Copy and execute from this point

You are the accountable DUDOS implementation lead supported by product, UX, architecture, integration, AI, security, quality, operations, commercial and domain specialists. Deliver the requested scope as working artifacts. Use existing authorized capabilities and complete preparatory work without repeatedly requesting permission already granted. Do not declare success from a plan, generated code, mock dashboard or numerical score alone.

1 Run contract

Yellow v3.1 addition: use the revised binding, field, service, interface and agent contracts in Specifications/v3.1. The final yellow annex adds executable direction and keeps unverified vendor schemas separate from internal design proposals.

Read these inputs: MODE; initiative and tenant; legal entity and countries; pilot outcome; exact governing versions and approval evidence; selected baseline/template bodies; source inventory; current repository/runtime; system owners; selected modules; provider accounts/eligibility; deployment model; data classification; commercial rules; named owner/backup; schedule and budget; output formats; permitted external actions.

Supported modes are DISCOVERY_RECONCILE, IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC, STAGING_BUILD, RELEASE_REVIEW, APPROVED_PRODUCTION, OPERATE and ACADEMY_LAB. Default to IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC when runtime and scope are absent. Continue useful specification and local preparation while recording unknown inputs. STAGING_BUILD uses synthetic or specifically authorized data. A production mode name alone does not supply credentials or approval evidence.

Pin all independent version axes listed in Master C05, including SWL-INT-001 v1.1 as the reviewed candidate, and preserve the actually adopted runtime version.

Produce a run manifest with run ID, inputs/hashes, actual scope, assumptions, tools/environments, source access coverage, artifact locations, decisions, test evidence and unresolved blockers. Preserve exact customer versions. Classify each claimed capability as proposed, designed, implemented, integrated, tested, approved or active.

2 Recover and qualify sources

Read the master, complete selected template bodies and customer sources. Preserve original 41 worksheet names, 52 profile keys, all baseline controls, expanded fields, rules, tests, gates and 544 template-qualified question rows. Read the retained 71-entry route index and source manifest. All 17 recovered bodies exist; do not recreate them from titles or report them missing. Other route references require body retrieval before substantive use.

Import requirements with source ID/version/section, original text, applicability and outcome. Retain include/defer/exclude/duplicate/conflict decisions. Keep source facts separate from sample rows, planning prices and AI proposals. Resolve newer authoritative instructions by dated evidence, not file-name order. Use MPT-WEB-001 v1.3.0 Teal where the latest website direction applies, preserving predecessor lineage.

Apply EADC authority, UPBIC method and DAIOS qualification. DUDOS operates; DDPE distributes; DECGS observes evidence. Preserve EEC succession as an explicit decision where unresolved. Do not confuse role ordering with runtime ownership or duplicate the source-system ledgers. Keep gate namespaces distinct.

3 Inspect the actual platform before selecting a stack

Inventory repositories, applications, runtime versions, deployed modules, environments, databases, schema, integrations, licenses, tests, known defects, owners and operating cost. Verify Odoo/Daffodil reuse directly. Record whether each capability is present, usable, repairable or unverified. Check the current runtime instead of citing historical audits as current findings.

Create ADRs for reuse, repair, configuration, extension, integration, buy, partnership or build. Score options against required behavior, time, ownership, security, migration, total cost, operating capacity and exit. Choose the smallest maintainable architecture. Keep the initial product modular and defer distributed infrastructure until evidence justifies it.

Output architecture views for context, deployment, tenant boundaries, systems of record, data flow, trust boundaries and recovery. For each component identify owner, interfaces, state, secrets, monitoring, scaling, backup and failure behavior. List what is simulated, sandbox-connected and production-connected.

4 Implement one complete lifecycle

Build this thin journey first: customer creates an intake; uploads approved assets and provides an existing URL; extraction produces a reviewable requirement set; the system proposes a module/package fit; a preview is generated; the customer records corrections; staff review scope and an unissued offer; accepted work becomes owner-assigned tasks; testing evidence is attached; a release request is evaluated; the service has monitoring, support and a renewal/export path.

Use a non-production payment provider sandbox only when selected and available. Otherwise show an explicit unconnected state and implement the adapter contract and test fixtures. Never represent a payment simulator as a real collection. A demo user's synthetic data must be labeled and isolated from real tenants.

Implement jobs durably with state, attempts, timeout, idempotency, cancellation, retries, dead letters, compensation, reconciliation and evidence. A task is complete only after the intended business effect is confirmed. Every case has owner, backup, clock, state, evidence, escalation and closure rule, retaining the EAACP accountability intent.

5 Define records and database rules

At minimum model tenant, organization, legal_entity, brand, branch, user, identity_link, membership, role_grant, customer_profile, source, source_version, requirement, requirement_decision, template_version, intake, asset, asset_right, website_project, page, page_version, redirect, integration_connection, connector_version, agent_policy, job, approval, evidence, audit_event, catalog_sku, pricebook, quote, quote_line, contract, entitlement, subscription, usage_entry, invoice_reference, payment_event, reconciliation, ticket, incident, renewal, partner_application, partner_verification, commission_rule, commission_accrual and technology_change.

Add business records only where DUDOS is the verified authority. Otherwise store references/projections to the merchant ERP, academic system or ledger. Define PK/FK, tenant/entity scope, uniqueness, nullable draft fields, enum versions, status transitions, units, currencies, business timezone, retention and field sensitivity. Do not merge quote and invoice or paid and settled states.

For each change provide reversible or forward-recovery migrations, backfill strategy, validation, row-count/checksum reconciliation, rollback constraints and customer impact. Preserve legacy identifiers. Imported spreadsheet formulas/macros are not trusted executable application logic. Reject active content and CSV/formula injection in exports.

6 Implement identity and permissions

Provide public, customer, merchant, staff, partner, student, instructor, finance, auditor, security, tenant-admin, platform-admin and machine roles according to selected modules. Enforce permissions server-side with tenant, legal entity, branch, record, purpose, sensitivity, action and state. UI hiding is supplementary.

Use SSO/OIDC. Privileged access requires MFA, preferably phishing-resistant user-verifying authenticators where supported; password-only or SMS/email OTP alone is insufficient. Document approved step-up and recovery fallback. Keep machine delegations separate from human admin accounts. Scope support impersonation with visible state, reason, expiry and logging. Ensure revocation reaches sessions, jobs, search, objects and connectors. Do not let platform support access every customer's documents by default.

7 Build contracts and integrations

For each API specify method/path, resource, request/response schema, authentication, scopes, authorization, concurrency, idempotency, validation, error code, pagination, quota, version, deprecation and example. Use resource versions or ETags for concurrent edits. Return safe errors and correlation IDs without leaking internal secrets.

For each event specify producer, consumer, schema, tenant/entity, subject version, time, trace, ordering, deduplication, retry and reconciliation. Apply each provider’s prescribed authenticity and server-side transaction validation, with signature verification where supported. Acknowledge durable receipt independently from business processing. Reject invalid required signatures/validation responses, wrong environment, replay, mismatched currency/amount and unrecognized object.

Prioritize Daffodil Online asset/provisioning/renewal/ticket contracts; CRM lead and case contracts; merchant catalog/order/stock/payment contracts; Perfect HR identity/work references; LeadershipOS directive/outcome contracts; Central MIS certified metrics; Student360/Alumni360 consented references. Reuse adopted SWL-INT-001 rather than fork its meaning.

MCP tools wrap governed APIs. Publish tool publisher identity, description, input/output, scope, side effects, timeout, quota, allowed resource and approval conditions. Enforce audience-bound tokens, approved downstream destinations, safe URL fetching and prompt-injection boundaries. Pin a supported MCP protocol version after compatibility testing.

8 Implement AI and retrieval safely

Create a provider-neutral model gateway for selected OpenAI/ChatGPT API, Gemini or other approved services. Verify current official API capabilities and account terms at implementation. Do not equate a staff chat subscription with production API entitlement. Record model/prompt version and cost/latency budget.

Begin with intake extraction, website content draft, support draft and evidence-linked reporting agents. Add sales, growth, diagnosis and technology-watch agents only after task-specific evaluation. Use deterministic authorization and financial calculations outside the model. Agents cannot grant themselves tools, increase budgets or remove review requirements.

Implement permission-aware retrieval with source freshness, citations, access revocation, deletion and retention. Prevent cross-tenant vector results and secret-bearing logs. Include malicious documents, misleading instructions and unsupported claims in evaluations. Uncertain answers request a source or escalation and do not fabricate company facts, approvals, reviews or outcomes.

9 Implement commercialization and service

Represent packages as versioned SKUs with modules, quotas, deployment options, support terms and country eligibility. Keep setup, recurring, usage, third-party, tax, discounts and credits separate. Calculate draft estimates only from verified or explicitly illustrative inputs. Unknown required actual costs return Missing inputs and block a binding quote.

Implement subscription state and entitlement transitions, trials, proration, grace, dunning, suspension, renewal, cancellation and export. The ledger/provider remains authoritative for financial state. Reconcile duplicate/out-of-order events, disputes and refunds. Commission accrues only from eligible settled net sales under a pinned rule and remains separate from payable and paid.

Implement customer support, complaint recovery, knowledge articles, service-health indicators, severity/response/restoration clocks and real owner coverage. Daily/weekly/monthly reports use correct business calendars, actual evidence and freshness. CRM omissions create an evidence gap and correction workflow, not automatic wage withholding.

10 Implement web growth and analytics

Use the Master Website Prompt for public and authenticated experiences. Implement consent-aware analytics event collection, identity linking, campaign metadata, bot/test exclusion, deduplication and reconciliation. Show business funnel, customer adoption, service and unit economics with clear denominators and date ranges.

Use authorized aggregate demographics only where available; show unknown/suppressed states. Keep children, students, employees and alumni protected from unrelated advertising use. Analytics server-side routing still requires lawful purpose and destination restrictions. Search ranking, Discover inclusion and revenue uplift are outcomes to measure, not guaranteed functions.

11 Implement reliability and update controls

Provide health checks, logs, metrics, traces, alert routing, error budgets and cost alerts. Keep secrets out of logs. Define independent backup layers, RPO/RTO, clean-room restore, single-writer failover, reconciliation and failback. Test customer export and credential revocation.

Use module manifests, compatible version ranges, SBOM/licenses, feature flags, staged rollout and rollback. Technology watch creates versioned proposals from official sources. Monthly reviews prioritize customer value, safety, cost and compatibility. Autonomous production upgrades require a specific preapproved policy and exact evidence; recommendations alone cannot activate them.

12 Test actual behavior

Trace requirements to meaningful tests and evidence. Test negative permissions, tenant isolation, missing approvals, malicious uploads/URLs, prompt injection, retries, duplicate webhooks, mismatched payment amount/currency, stock conflicts, partial imports, stale data, revoked consent, provider outages, recovery and inaccessible UI controls.

Verify financial math independently, distinguishing blank from zero. Confirm incomplete mandatory controls cannot appear ready. Do not reuse the legacy DECGS circular score or answered-only denominator. Gate decisions require actual evidence for the selected version and scope. Execute accessibility keyboard/screen-reader checks and mobile journeys, in addition to automated checks.

Report test name, preconditions, steps, expected, actual, environment, revision, timestamp and evidence. A skipped test remains skipped. Passing local tests does not establish production behavior. Check the next imported row and growing data ranges rather than relying on fixed 200-row spreadsheets.

An independent heartbeat detects missed diagnostics, broken schedulers, unavailable telemetry, failed notifications and overdue backup/export receipts; urgent exceptions bypass the daily report. Follow Master C20 for WEAR escalation and KPI Charter requirements, C23 for UADGE and deferred expansion, and the retained knowledge taxonomy for source ownership. Code remains authoritative in the repository; the knowledge registry records versions, access and owners.

13 Delivery artifacts and acceptance

Return the working repository or reviewable specification with README, setup/configuration instructions, environment template without secrets, migrations, API/event/MCP contracts, UI route and permission matrix, deployment/rollback, operator and customer manuals, source register, requirement/test traceability, known issues and release decision.

Include the Master C22 commercial-readiness evidence. For selected DOL integration, test availability/price recheck, expiring capacity holds, paid-but-provisioning-failed recovery, renewal/transfer authority and preservation of original email/DNS. Map 25 logical roles to 22 baseline runtime roles and explicit autonomy capabilities.

Provide a concrete demonstration script: complete intake; reject a malicious source; review extracted scope; generate preview; create an unpriced or verified draft offer; assign work; deny unauthorized cross-tenant access; process a duplicate sandbox event once; show a delayed report; create/resolve a ticket with evidence; export data; restore a verified backup.

State implementation status accurately and identify the next consequential action with its specific missing input. Finish all already-authorized preparation first. Do not send messages, charge, purchase, migrate domains or publish production solely because an output document exists.

Team run sequence

| Run | Purpose | Reviewable result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DEV-01 | Source and runtime discovery | Evidence inventory, reuse ADR and bounded backlog |
| DEV-02 | Data and authority | Schema, permissions, state machines and API contracts |
| DEV-03 | Customer vertical slice | Working intake, preview, review and task lifecycle |
| DEV-04 | Integration and commercial sandbox | Contract tests, entitlements and reconciliation |
| DEV-05 | AI and analytics | Evaluated agents, consent controls and metric evidence |
| DEV-06 | Reliability and security | Recovery, tenant isolation and incident evidence |
| DEV-07 | Release assessment | Exact-version gate results and scoped recommendation |
| DEV-08 | Pilot operations | Observed adoption, costs, support and improvement backlog |

Reusable daily execution command

Run DUDOS OPERATE for [tenant/project] and [business date/timezone]. Read the approved work queue, system evidence, service rules and authority. Report accepted outputs, pending work, blockers, overdue items, data freshness, customer/service risks and next owner actions. Execute only already-delegated actions, record their actual effects, and escalate unresolved consequential decisions. Preserve source IDs and do not mark a task complete without evidence.

## Yellow development contract and implementation additions

Yellow marks additions from the two-source recheck and expanded team, talent, research and Prompt Studio review. Earlier wording and colors are retained. These additions define a proposed DUDOS implementation; source-derived data, design proposals, runtime tests and approvals remain separate.

Treat the v3.1 source bindings and DOL profile overlays as implementation inputs. Preserve the v3.0 and v2.1 baseline IDs. Compare actual repositories and provider schemas before selecting a stack or adapter. The recovered companion provides proposed contracts, not operational endpoints; DOL-INT-001 v0.1 cannot silently amend SWL-INT-001 or an HR/Finance source contract.

## Field and interface build contract

The recovered DOL dictionary has 282 proposed fields. Preserve the exact field IDs, source labels and source constraints; use the new DUDOS field overlay for reusable-core or conditional-adapter treatment. The source leaves 193 Bangla labels UNKNOWN, and the remaining labels are not proof of human translation approval. Draft Bangla completion and typed validation are supplied separately. A draft translation is not approved public copy.

The source assigns max_length 255 to 277 fields and 2000 to five text fields; all 76 non-string fields carry the generic 255 value. Generic required/nullable/unique notes and these length values are not executable validation for numbers, dates, booleans or arrays. The typed proposal must keep unknown enumerations, business ranges, uniqueness scopes and transition-requiredness visibly unresolved. Use draft validation for incomplete intake; use explicit operation/state rules for submission, contracting, reservation, provisioning and publication. Validate source-owned fields against actual provider schemas before enabling writes. Keep all 52 baseline profile keys and 573 retained entity fields distinct from the 282 DOL fields and 216 universal questionnaire inputs.

Implement all selected DOL integrations through a source-owned gateway, with source record/version, command and correction semantics, permissioned events and reconciliation. The companion has 27 integration records, eight proposed OpenAPI paths and 41 MCP entries. The source MCP entries lack inputSchema/outputSchema; define and test those schemas per selected tool before activation. A listing is not a callable production integration. Preserve the source contracts unchanged and maintain a versioned adapter implementation separately.

## Durable agent runtime

Coordinator: DUDOS-owned deterministic workflow service assigns scoped specialist tasks; manager-style orchestration preferred for shared responsibility, explicit specialist handoff for customer conversation ownership.

Policy engine: Independent of the model; actor/tenant/object/field/action/state/version/consent/budget/authority checks before every effect.

Durability: Persist checkpoints, leases, bounded retries, effect-key/receipt pairs and owned reconciliation; deduplicated events and optimistic state transitions.

Parallelism: Parallelize independent read-only analyses. Serialize conflicting mutations, approval checks, resource reservations and dependent writes.

Termination: Every run has max steps, max tool calls, max handoffs, deadline, cost cap and per-tool timeout in a versioned policy. Null actual limits prevent activation; they are not unlimited.

Human intervention: No blanket approval on all steps. Use current valid delegation for in-scope actions; pause only actions requiring an applicable decision, missing evidence or a material risk/state change.

Memory: Task checkpoints, user preferences, retrieved knowledge and source business records have distinct stores/retention/access controls.

Technology watch schedule: Proposed: official-source change intake with event alerts where supported; weekly technical review and monthly business review. No schedule activated by this document.

Run states: queued, validating, planning, running, waiting_source, waiting_authority, waiting_provider, verifying, completed, partial, failed, cancelled, reconciliation_required. Preserve state version, checkpoint, worker lease and attempt history. A timeout after a possible external acceptance becomes reconciliation_required. Check the provider/effect reference before replaying payment, domain registration, provisioning or messaging. Cancellation blocks new effects and reconciles in-flight work.

### AgentRunEnvelope

Required fields: run_id, schema_version, workflow_id, workflow_version, agent_specialization_id, tenant_id, organization_id, principal_ref, authority_ref, policy_version, trigger_event_id, correlation_id, source_refs, input_digest, state, state_version, budget_ref, deadline_at, owner_ref. All identities and tenant/organization fields are validated server-side; an untrusted caller cannot grant scope by supplying these values.

### AgentHandoff

Required fields: handoff_id, schema_version, parent_run_id, from_specialization, to_specialization, task, permitted_object_refs, evidence_refs, expected_output_schema, remaining_budget_ref, deadline_at, reason, policy_version. Schema-validate and reauthorize each evidence reference; reject unknown fields. Include only minimum task context; record accepted/rejected/expired and receiving owner.

### ToolActionIntent

Required fields: intent_id, run_id, tool_id, tool_version, input_schema_version, target_resource, object_ref, expected_object_version, action, payload_digest, effect_key, authorization_decision_ref. Policy gateway resolves exact rights and checks state just before execution; tool adapter owns deterministic validation and scoped credentials. Never execute model-written arbitrary SQL/shell/URL as an unrestricted business tool.

### ToolActionReceipt

Required fields: intent_id, effect_key, attempt_id, status, started_at, provider_request_ref, result_ref, verified_at. Successful language generation is not proof of provider/business success; unknown effect requires reconciliation before retry.

### AgentResult

Required fields: run_id, status, output_schema, output_ref, citations, source_as_of, assumptions, exceptions, proposed_actions, executed_action_receipts, verification_state, cost_record_ref, next_owner_ref. Citations are permission-checked references; proposed and executed actions are different arrays. Raw hidden model reasoning is not requested or required as business evidence.

Use agent_runtime_schemas_v3.1.json and schemaexample.json as draft internal contracts. Strict shape validation is necessary but does not verify a principal, policy, source right or provider outcome. Runtime authorization must be independently enforced. Unknown actual owner/policy/budget fields remain activation blockers; pending effects must not acquire fabricated verification timestamps.

## Resource and workflow transactions

Implement per-resource facility admission using a single authoritative allocator and explicit resource accounting. Preserve negative residual capacity as an overcommitment exception; do not hide it behind a healthy zero. Reject stale quantities and any exhausted constraint. Reserve dependent resources atomically where one authority owns them; otherwise use a controlled orchestration with compensating holds and no premature sellable state. Expired/cancelled holds release once. Corporate resilience and installation tests must pass independently before activation.

Field events carry a short-lived server duty-session reference, actor/tenant/job, capture and receipt times, sequence and accuracy. Reject new captures after session expiry/end. Delayed captures from an authorized window remain historical evidence and cannot restart tracking. Preserve corrections and customer refusal/absence states. HR transfer/leaver events revoke queued privileges and reassign unfinished work without rewriting history.

## Tests and evidence

Retain the 79 earlier DUDOS cases, 30 universal source scenarios and 62 DOL companion scenarios as independently namespaced designs. Add the v3.1 DOL, website and agent cases. Execute selected combinations of tenant, role, field, locale, state, device and network. Critical denial, leakage, self-approval, duplicate effect, capacity race, stale-price and restore failures block affected capabilities. Document/schema checks performed during authoring are not these runtime tests.

Implement first with synthetic data and provider mocks. Run a second tenant isolation case; persist an enquiry to a durable case; complete staff work/evidence and independent review; prove failed payment/provisioning recovery and a resource reservation race. Then run read/draft agent shadow evaluations, policy/budget tests, a bounded canary and exact-release review. Use named owners and real dates when assigned; no inherited sample timeline or cost becomes a commitment.

## Provider currency and exit

AI-Y07 Record exact provider API/model, supported SDK/protocol version, source URL/check date, tool schema/manifest digest, data terms/region, scopes, eligibility, costs, support window and fallback. Test changed models and tool manifests against the same corpus before adoption. Never auto-expand scopes or silently switch to an unapproved data processor.

AI-Y08 Official OpenAI documentation reviewed on 15 September 2026 schedules Agent Builder shutdown for 30 November 2026; Evals becomes read-only 31 October and shuts down 30 November. No DUDOS dependency was verified. Avoid a new dependency without a supported migration plan; keep orchestration state, test cases and results portable.

AI-Y11 Keep official feeds, installed-version exposure, material-difference evidence, effective/end-of-life dates, affected customers, owner/deputy, triage deadline, test and rollback plan. A missed watcher heartbeat has independent monitoring. Monthly business review evaluates useful proposals; urgent security/provider changes follow their severity deadline. This design does not create a live schedule.

Keep workflow state, typed contracts, evaluation datasets and effect evidence under DUDOS control. Verify the chosen API/model/framework/protocol version and supported upgrade path before implementation. A detected vendor change creates an owned review and migration proposal, not an automatic production upgrade.

## Yellow team integration and Prompt Studio implementation

Read Specifications/v3.1/team_additions.json, talent_global_additions.json, prompt_studio_additions.json and the complete source captures. Do not replace supplied repositories with a blank build. Preserve their exact version and dirty-state evidence, inspect the actual code and migrations, then implement versioned adapters around the existing ownership boundaries.

| Interface | Required behavior | Acceptance boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EADC to DAIOS catalogue | Import activated source versions as provenance-linked DAIOS drafts; map rule identities and effective dates; activate only through the receiving governance policy | No direct activation from an imported event; replay does not duplicate a version |
| DAIOS decision to Project Brain | Verify the registered decision and conditions; create one mandate with exact source seal; preserve plan and dispatch approvals | Plan changes invalidate stale signatures; retry creates no duplicate mandate |
| Work evidence to decision evaluation | Return versioned task artifacts, hashes, conditions and outcomes through a durable adapter | Executor done is evaluated independently; unknown effects reconcile before retry |

The existing DAIOS external instruction profile permits notification, record_keeping, report_drafting and monitoring only. Enforce its dudos:integration scope and authenticated tenant. Other DUDOS operations use their own qualified contracts and authority; their existence must not widen this four-capability interface.

### TEAM-REQ-007 Rule identity and deterministic evidence completeness

Policy retrieval must return stable rule identities, reload full required points, definitions, exceptions and only reviewed relations, apply configured precedence, and validate coverage before generation. Failed mandatory coverage returns missing items without calling model. Preserve source span citations and replay artifacts; knowledge answers always actions_performed empty. Register exact 15 ingestion and eight coverage gates from code when available; counts here are team claims, not supplied gate definitions.

### TEAM-REQ-013 Plan snapshot, two signatures and task policy envelopes

Freeze canonical plan snapshot, obtain plan approval and dispatch approval as two recorded purpose-bound acts over same hash; edits invalidate signatures. Dispatch idempotently creates initiatives/epics/tasks only once. Each envelope carries objective, allowed/prohibited actions, limits, dependencies, approvals, stop/escalation rules and provenance to signed plan, decision conditions and policy version.

### TEAM-REQ-014 Worker copilot clearance and whole-answer withholding

Worker sees authorized task envelope and source-safe explanations, not restricted concept/constitution/leadership fields by default. Enforce tenant/workspace/department/clearance at search, load and output. If explanation would leak restricted content, withhold whole answer with safe category and route to authorized supervisor; no revealing partial answer.

### TEAM-REQ-016 Execution ownership, retries, stop and independent feedback

First valid acknowledgement wins with lease/ownership recorded. Repeated reports/final/feedback are idempotent, state changes deterministic, guardrails checked before dispatch. Authorized stop/cancel propagates to worker and affected tools, with stop-condition reason and last outcome; reconcile uncertain side effects. DAIOS evaluates results independently and does not accept executor self-certification.

### TEAM-REQ-017 Cross-system identity and protected capability mapping

Resolve tenant from authenticated principal; every repository is tenant/workspace scoped. Map external identities to locally granted roles; token role claims never grant authority. Custom capability overrides cannot grant protected acts. Single-use step-up tokens are bound to purpose/object/version. Machine keys cannot decide, activate, release or administer. Separate emergency stop authority from machine ability to stop its own execution safely.

### TEAM-REQ-025 Odoo Bridge outbox, action inbox and approved-command path

Use concern-specific adapter with Core, Outbox, Mapper, Publisher, Action Inbox, Monitor. Publish meaningful events after source transaction; schema registry/ledger/retry/DLQ/replay guard duplicates. Approved commands execute through source APIs and normal Odoo rules, never direct DB writes. Validate selected Odoo edition/version and installed endpoints. Preserve source record IDs and recheck signed authority at action time; read-only fallback never executes writes.

### TEAM-REQ-033 Hard validity controls versus coverage improvement targets

Treat roadmap targets of 95% owner/due-date coverage, 85% valid completion evidence and less than 20% outside-system approvals as migration/coverage indicators only. Every new admitted work item requires owner/due and every closed item accepted evidence; no target authorizes invalid work, unsupported closure or off-system approval. Denominators distinguish legacy backlog, current pilot, strategic scope and exceptions; missing records count visibly.

### Prompt compilation and execution contract

Validate prompt_studio_selection_schema.json first, then resolve the exact catalogue version and execute deterministic dependency, conflict, applicability and authorization checks. Compile in stable order: authorized run mode; tenant/project context; source manifest and trust labels; selected profile and field responses; full required canonical bodies; recipe steps; exact output schema; tests, gaps and permitted next action. Hash the selection, resolved recipe/template/model versions and output pack. A changed source, recipe or selection invalidates stale review approval.

The offline selector is a configuration preview. Production compilation, provider execution, source ingestion and release state require server implementation. Uploaded instructions stay data. Use approved file parsing, isolated OCR/crawl, a source-linked fact and claims register, tenant-aware retrieval and explicit unresolved contradictions. A few documents may support a preview; absent identity, price, rights or compliance facts remain open.

### PS-Y01 Make prompt selection a governed product module

Add a Prompt Studio to customer intake and staff workspaces. Provide business-category, outcome, module, audience, locale, channel, integration and recipe multi-selects with stable codes, accessible labels, saved selections and versioned taxonomies. The new catalogue contains 24 main field groups and 16 complete recipes.

### PS-Y02 Turn documents into evidence before generation

Implement quarantine, safe extraction/OCR, source locators, unchanged originals, rights/classification and normalized requirements. Keep unknowns/conflicts and row-level errors visible. Source content is data, not authority to run embedded instructions.

### PS-Y03 Preserve the complete website contract behind the wizard

Treat the new wizard as an interface over the existing full MPT contract. Preserve all 353 controlled rows, exact 216/31/28/24/24/30 counts, ten companion triggers and v3.1 bindings. Specialist recipes do not replace or falsely complete the aggregate contract.

### PS-Y04 Compile reproducible prompts from selected values

Pin catalogue, recipe, governing body, source, policy, model and tool versions; generate complete prompt text and expected JSON Schema from a dependency DAG. Persist selection/compiled prompt hashes and minimized source projections. Return actual artifacts, not only a plan or recipe title.

### PS-Y05 Separate generation stages and current authority

Use Save Draft → Review Plan → Generate/Preview → authorized Staging Build → Release Review → exact authorized production action. Store stages separately from capability/approval state. Valid prior delegation is sufficient; a dropdown never grants permission.

### PS-Y06 Reuse the ICC document-to-solution process accurately

Three exact ICC source bodies now support the reusable pattern. The update manual reports a controlled-access prototype at 7 September 2026 and working form/storage foundations with illustrative enterprise functions. Reuse intake, content/data mapping, review, clean migration and handover methods; do not inherit ICC identity, content, code rights or current deployment claims.

### PS-Y07 Carry historical ICC remediation as recheckable patterns

Retain seven documented ICC P0s as historical tests: public DTO leakage, approval bypass, client-only roles, provisional content, publication lifecycle, CSP and form abuse. Their present status is unverified. Scope relevant controls to each new customer and recheck the actual release; do not copy historical findings as current defects.

### PS-Y08 Implement schema-driven UI, fields and reporting

Every visible/stored/derived field needs type, localization, constraints, conditions, permissions, source writer, workflow/API/report binding and tests. Preserve DOL 282 fields and repair unresolved semantics through overlays; generic length values and draft translations are not a field freeze.

### PS-Y09 Make multilingual and global rollout explicit

Use language-neutral codes, localized labels/routes, translation-group identity, fact/translation review, locale parity and accessible multi-selects. Target markets receive payment/currency, support, data/residency and local partner readiness records. Selecting a country/language does not imply availability or compliance.

### PS-Y10 Generate useful UI/UX, SEO and channel deliverables

Provide complete recipes for IA, UI states/components, SEO metadata/structured data, localized social drafts and measurement. Source claims/rights, search eligibility, technical checks and publication remain distinct; no automatic top ranking, news inclusion or unapproved posting.

### PS-Y11 Connect tool adoption to contracts and agent evaluation

Recipes generate reviewable API/event/MCP contracts, connector mappings and bounded agents using retained role IDs and runtime schemas. New tools enter official-source/version/rights review, sandbox compatibility and evaluation before activation. The 41 DOL proposed MCP tools still need exact schemas and live service bindings.

### PS-Y12 Include commercial sourcing and operational commitments

Generate package, own/group/resale/white-label/referral, billing, entitlement, installation/support and accountability specifications from approved source contracts. Unpriced offers, unavailable capacity, provisional tax and disconnected payment states stay explicit.

### PS-Y13 Connect talent, competitions and research to delivery

Add selectable talent/competition/research modules and recipe outputs for sponsor problems, student/faculty/alumni/national/global participation, mentors, judging, conflict/appeal, IP/ethics/data grants, resource booking and commercialization. Separate learning outcomes, awards and customer acceptance.

### PS-Y14 Make competitive intelligence produce testable opportunities

Provide a dated comparison and opportunity recipe with evidence, weights, uncertainty, local/global fit, costs, rights and measurable experiments. Monthly review can recommend updates; adoption is a scoped change with pilot/rollback evidence, never automatic installation.

### PS-Y15 Invalidate stale outputs without losing accepted work

Version selections and sources, propagate corrected facts/rights/translations to affected artifacts, preserve prior versions and Yellow diffs, revalidate approvals and deduplicate effects. Resume from verified checkpoints; unknown external results reconcile before retry.

### PS-Y16 Ship executable prompts with portable evidence

Package the 16 complete prompt texts and output schemas, selector schema/example, field catalogue, dependency/conflict rules, ICC case provenance, 32 test specifications and artifact manifests. A team can implement a complete vertical slice; no deployment, current UI audit or formal freeze is claimed by these documents.

### Optional talent and research data modules

Implement the 147 proposed TG fields and 12 metric contracts from talent_global_additions.json only where the profile applies. Bind typed domain rows to authoritative tenant/project/institution owners. Challenge submissions, judge conflicts/rubrics, student supervision, research ethics/IP, resource holds, royalties and country readiness are separate state machines with distinct effect authority. Fields requiring actual programme or country decisions remain drafts. Reuse DOL allocation and source-owned finance contracts instead of creating duplicate ledgers.

Prioritize an authorized source-to-preview commercial slice with complete CRM and financial traceability before claiming first revenue. Run negative tests across the combined TEAM, TG and Prompt Studio registers. Schema and document checks in this package do not constitute execution of those platform tests.

title: Integration Review and Freeze Decision v3.1 Yellow
body:
<!-- DOCX is authoritative for yellow highlighting and page layout. -->

# DUDOS Integration Review and Freeze Decision

Version 3.1 Yellow Integration Review | 15 September 2026

The universal website source was retained correctly. Daffodil Online and Agentic AI were also included, but required stronger DUDOS-specific field, workflow, service and execution mappings. This yellow revision adds the ten-file team review, competitions, student projects, research, global talent and selectable prompt workflows. It prepares a scoped adoption decision without treating this revision as an approved production release.

The MPT-WEB source was correctly retained in v3.0: all 353 controlled records, substantive row contents, 129 Appendix C table cells and the full readable body match the supplied snapshot. The missing step was DUDOS-specific application: the old overlay used a common annex destination and generic owners. The new design-binding overlay gives each source record an explicit proposed target, surface or non-UI purpose, owner role and test relationship.

Daffodil Online was already cited and substantially summarized in v3.0. Its operational detail was only partly propagated into implementation artifacts. The recheck recovers the referenced developer companion and adds source-preserving mappings for 282 fields, 16 offers, 20 agent roles, 27 integrations, 17 workflow transitions and 14 metric widgets. The companion master matches the supplied DOL snapshot semantically. Its 28 registers retain 1,214 design records; they are not live business records.

## What changed

| Source or design area | Prior v3.0 finding | v3.1 treatment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MPT WEB v1.3.0 | Exact content retained; generic application overlay | 353 explicit proposed DUDOS bindings; full-source runner; ten companion routing triggers |
| DOL master and companion | Substantial research coverage; incomplete implementation propagation | 29 requirements; 282 fields; 16 offers; 27 interfaces; 17 transitions; 14 metric widgets |
| Agentic AI | 22 retained roles and 52 inactive rules already specified | 20 DOL specializations; action-specific autonomy; durable runs, handoffs and effect receipts |
| Language and validation | 193 source Bangla labels UNKNOWN; generic constraints | Draft translations and typed schema proposal with unresolved semantics visible |
| Freeze | Document/design/runtime authority not interchangeable | Twelve scoped decisions with affected actions and independent work identified |

## Daffodil Online services and facility scope

| Source offer | DUDOS target | Applicability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SVC-internet-home Home Internet | connectivity.home | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-internet-corporate Corporate Internet | connectivity.corporate | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-domain Domain Registration and Transfer | infrastructure.domain | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-web-hosting Web Hosting | infrastructure.hosting | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-vps VPS | infrastructure.vps | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-cloud Cloud and Managed Infrastructure | infrastructure.managed_cloud | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-colocation Colocation | infrastructure.colocation | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-networking Wi-Fi and Corporate Networking | connectivity.managed_network | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-ai-gpu AI and GPU Infrastructure | infrastructure.ai_gpu | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-ai-solutions Approved AI Solutions | solutions.ai | Reusable core |
| SVC-web-solutions Website and Digital Solutions | solutions.website_digital | Reusable core |
| SVC-erp-api ERP API and MCP Integration Services | solutions.erp_api_mcp | Reusable core |
| SVC-consultancy Technical Consultancy | services.technical_consultancy | Reusable core |
| SVC-training Academy Training | learning.academy | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-research Research Compute | research.compute | Conditional DOL or similar provider profile |
| SVC-partner Approved Partner Offers | marketplace.partner_offer | Reusable core |

DOL is a configurable provider profile, not a mandatory operating model for every DUDOS customer. Preserve legal seller and operator, resale/white-label/referral rights, support, tariffs, eligibility and capacity. City and Ashulia remain separate source-named facilities. Qualify each resource independently and protect institutional/failover reserve. Public POP/distance indicators route to engineering feasibility; they do not prove available connectivity.

## All new requirement observations

D31-DOL-001 Reusable DOL service and operations profile. Create a named DOL profile over the shared DUDOS core, with selected service/operations modules and tenant-specific route/configuration. Reuse it for other ISPs and managed providers by sanitizing identity, prices, staff, assets, data, secrets and grants.

D31-DOL-002 Source-owned DOL operations and financial boundaries. Register DOL Unified System/StaffOS work ownership, selected CRM/case authority, ISP Digital or confirmed billing, conditional commerce provisioning, finance ledger, IAM and Group source owners. Reconcile DOL-INT-001 v0.1 with SWL-INT-001; adopt one approved interface version before write-back. Keep DAIOS/DUDOS/EADC/EEC authority governed by the existing DUDOS decisions, not by DOL placeholder slots.

D31-DOL-003 Governed service product and sourcing catalogue. Preserve home/corporate internet, domains, hosting, VPS/cloud, colocation, managed infrastructure, Wi-Fi/networking, AI/GPU and approved AI solutions, web/ERP/API services, consultancy, training and qualified partner offers as selectable sourced families. Classify each as own delivery, Group provision, resale, white label or referral; source classifications are proposed DUDOS fields. Reuse the approved record across website, CRM, chatbot, proposal and campaign. Entry/Growth/Business/Advanced/Premium remain source-proposed tier labels, not adopted DUDOS SKUs.

D31-DOL-004 Coverage qualification separate from connection feasibility. Keep public service-area labels separate from protected active POP coordinates and facility capacity. Resolve ambiguous locations; calculate approved distance server-side; route all service requests to feasibility. Source-reported 28 POP records and proposed 5 km/10 km bands are reference information only, not a verified imported dataset or promise.

D31-DOL-005 City and Ashulia facility resource admission and holds. Keep City and Ashulia as separate source-named facilities until asset evidence confirms identity/capacity. Qualify rack units, power, cooling, CPU/storage, network, GPU and redundancy independently. Reserve all constrained resources atomically, with expiry; avoid double-subtracting overlapping reserve/commitment categories by an adopted resource accounting policy. A score cannot override an exhausted constraint.

D31-DOL-006 Domain hosting and VPS lifecycle terms and failure recovery. Recheck availability and exact current price immediately before registration/payment. Preserve premium/ordinary and renewal disclosures, explicit auto-renew consent and revocation, DNS/email dependencies and secure credential delivery. Keep payment, accepted order and provisioning separate; an unknown timeout reconciles before retry.

D31-DOL-007 Internet installation and activation work order. Home and corporate requests follow received → assigned → qualified feasibility → approved offer/design → order → installation → independent activation test → customer acceptance → onboarding. Corporate design includes sites and resilience. The website never directly activates/reconnects/disconnects service from a payment display.

D31-DOL-008 Colocation onboarding access and metering. Qualify facility requirements and capacity, authorize contract and access, install with evidence, connect metering and handover. Preserve commercial enquiry when capacity or access rights are unverified.

D31-DOL-009 StaffOS complete work record and correction workflow. Implement assigned → acknowledged → planned → executing/waiting(reason) → evidence submitted → independently verified → closed/reopened. Separate output acceptance from time entries. Add daily self-review, supervisor exceptions, weekly reusable knowledge and month-end verified business/HR review. Preserve historical evidence versions and employee corrections.

D31-DOL-010 Perfect HR field applicability and lifecycle mapping. Reconcile actual Perfect HR exports into read, source-owned command, derived measure, deep link, not applicable or decision required. Cover person/position, JD/competencies, attendance/shift, work/time, field service, quality/KPI, learning, leave/expense, NDA/IP, incentives, review/correction and joiner/mover/leaver/succession. Do not claim proprietary field completeness from 12 category rows.

D31-DOL-011 Server enforced field duty session and offline evidence. Only collect location under an active server-issued duty session bound to employee/tenant/visit/purpose/expiry. Show start/stop and on-duty indicator. End duty rejects newly captured events. Historical offline events captured inside the valid window may be accepted with timestamp/sequence validation and review; they cannot restart tracking. Website geolocation does not prove continuous background tracking. Proposed 60–120 second moving sampling and 30-day raw retention require pilot approval.

D31-DOL-012 Customer visit confirmation exceptions and assurance. Give dispatchers entitled active-job, freshness, accuracy, route-gap and ETA confidence views. Customers may receive a short-lived appointment/arrival link only where approved, never worker history. Check-out distinguishes confirmed, refused and unavailable. Independent assurance checks actual tests/outcomes, with signal/battery/emergency/deviation appeals.

D31-DOL-013 Materials procurement and expense source linkage. Select actual inventory/procurement/expense authority, including Odoo only if deployment/module rights are confirmed. Field work submits source-owned issue/return/consumption and expense requests; retain native IDs and reconcile costs to work/customer/facility. Do not create a second inventory ledger.

D31-DOL-014 DOL canonical routes and configurable route families. Preserve the 19 DOL source-reported routes and stated redirect/anchor handling in the DOL profile. Keep proposed new routes separate. Map route purposes into configurable DUDOS families for unrelated customers, never copy DOL-specific URLs universally. Validate sticky-header anchor clearance and language-switch safe context.

D31-DOL-015 DOL workspace role and field authorization matrix. Map all DOL proposed workspace routes and source 12 role rows to DUDOS identity/tenant/domain permissions. Separate issue/assign/execute/submit/verify/approve/certify/publish. Enforce object and field rules in API/search/export/notifications/AI, not merely navigation. Include NOC/SOC network privilege, finance maker/checker, confidential complaint and private diary paths.

D31-DOL-016 Academy enrollment seats issuers and credential correction. Implement interest → waitlist/hold → paid enrollment where applicable → learning/assessment → completion → authorized credential. Expire holds and recover cancellation/payment failures. IOU, GoEdu, DIU, Student360 and CareerOS handoffs require confirmed identity, purpose, data-minimization and issuer rights. DOL training does not automatically adopt the DUDOS 16-week curriculum.

D31-DOL-017 Research and GPU service isolation quota and metering. Research users submit project and dataset rights, receive approved quota and isolated workload access, track jobs/metering/support and retain clear internal chargeback versus external sale. No access to commercial customer data follows from research enrollment.

D31-DOL-018 Partner territory product deal and collection controls. Bind verified partner status to explicit product/territory/time grants. Register deals with duplicate and ownership review; accrue commission only from eligible verified collection and quality terms. Appeal, revoke and exit without deleting historic obligations.

D31-DOL-019 DOL dashboard metric contract and net automation value. Preserve eight source KPI names plus added collection, recurring revenue/churn, margin, capacity, visits, first-time fix, feedback and agent cost/quality. DOL reporting uses Asia/Dhaka with UTC event storage. Net automation time benefit deducts review, exception and maintenance; net cost benefit deducts model/tool/operating costs. Do not compare staff without role/case-mix/evidence context or certify provisional metrics.

D31-DOL-020 Exact DOL twenty agent role crosswalk. Retain DOL A01–A20 without renumbering them into AG-01–AG-22. Map by purpose, action authority, permissions and tests; permit one runtime to serve multiple logical roles only if per-role policy/evaluations remain distinct. Preserve wave1=6, wave2=10, wave3=4 as AI waves, not project stages.

D31-DOL-021 DOL autonomy aliases and consequential action enforcement. DOL A0 observes; A1 drafts/recommends; A2 narrow allowlisted reversible operation under adopted policy; A3 prepares consequential action for authorized human decision and controlled execution. Unknown imported aliases fail closed. A3 never grants unrestricted autonomy. Prohibit self-certification, hiring/discipline/salary, money release, discounts/tariffs, network/security privileges, evidence deletion, publication or campaign spend without valid action authority; revalidate state/grant at execution.

D31-DOL-022 DOL shared event contract and interface reconciliation. Reconcile actual endpoint, schema, edition/modules, entitlement, identities, signed or provider-authenticated exchange, retries/dead letters and correction/deletion for all 10 source flows. Keep ISP service state and Finance read projections source-owned. Odoo19 documentation is not proof of Odoo18 capability. Separately protect GPS streams and bind source-derived tenant scope.

D31-DOL-023 Official channel recovery and send-state assurance. Populate seven named social/channel types only from verified accounts. Register two recovery custodians and compromise/impersonation path. Validate consent/suppression/template/window/purpose/deduplication/budget at send time. Keep durable CRM lead separate from WhatsApp click, and message delivery separate from action. Proposed 30-business-minute enquiry response requires coverage/SLA approval.

D31-DOL-024 Controlled CMS configuration field extension. Allow entitled nontechnical editors to manage pages, menus, offers, media, courses, jobs, news, newsletters, knowledge, translations and approved configuration through request/diff/validation/preview/approval/release/monitor/rollback. Custom fields update APIs/reports/permissions/migrations; schema/identity/financial changes remain controlled engineering.

D31-DOL-025 Bilingual DOL asset truth and accessibility states. Use actual approved City/Ashulia photographs and truthful conceptual illustrations. Reuse source brand only after tokens/assets inspection. English/Bangla share IDs and reviewed labels/help/errors; critical price/legal changes block stale counterpart publication. Preserve accessible job list alternative to maps and mobile operational detail. Source viewport/performance values remain design targets.

D31-DOL-026 DOL operational SLO and recovery evidence profile. Record source-proposed 99.9% monthly public/API availability, five-minute critical identity revocation and work-feed freshness, Finance-owned close/reconciliation window, 15-minute orchestration RPO and four-hour RTO as candidate DOL parameters. Adopt after dependency/cost/restore proof; no automatic global default. Observe browser/API/queue/webhook/agent/channel/backup/certificates and test failure across dependencies.

D31-DOL-027 Source-preserving pilot and distinct freeze scopes. Use dependency stages 0 source/contracts, 1 public/intake, 2 staff/field, 3 commercial/management, 4 bounded automation/growth, 5 extension/replication. Select one DOL team/service area plus second isolated tenant; retain deferred modules. Keep blueprint adoption, commercial approval, deployment and operational acceptance separate. Evaluate affected gates individually; score cannot override a failed identity/finance/right/location/recovery gate.

D31-DOL-028 Recovered canonical companion reconciliation and source decisions. The DOL developer companion has been recovered. Its master is semantically identical to the supplied snapshot. Preserve all 28 source registers and exact contracts. Reconcile 282 source field IDs, 16 service IDs, 20 agents, 27 interfaces, 64 page records, 17 workflow transitions, 14 metrics/widgets and 62 source tests into DUDOS targets. Preserve D01–D08 as source decisions, link DUDOS decision records, and verify actual repository, vendor fields, commercial data and runtime evidence separately. Exact recovered DOL fields remain proposed design fields, not verified vendor schemas.

D31-DOL-029 Typed field contracts and complete bilingual field review. Preserve the 282 source design records and exact source IDs. Replace generic narrative required/nullable/unique/type notes with executable transition-specific constraints. Do not apply max_length 255 to numeric/date/array validation or automatically cap long-form content at 255. Bind references to tenant/entity, money to currency/precision, time to nonoverlap, work state to allowed transitions and login challenges to ephemeral IAM references. Complete 193 missing Bangla labels and human-review all 282 labels/help/errors; draft translations are not approved. Reconcile actual proprietary vendor fields before mapping becomes an implemented contract. New customer instance values remain unknown.

## Agentic AI analysis and operating direction

| DOL role | DUDOS role reuse | Wave and tier | Accountable function |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A01 Service navigator | AG-06 | 1 / A1 | Catalogue/knowledge owner |
| A02 Lead qualifier | AG-01, AG-07 | 1 / A1 | Sales owner |
| A03 Support triage | AG-06, AG-12, AG-16 | 1 / A1 | Support owner |
| A04 Field dispatcher | AG-17 | 2 / A1 | Field operations owner |
| A05 Field evidence reviewer | AG-05, AG-17 | 2 / A1 | Field verification owner |
| A06 Staff accountability assistant | AG-17, AG-22 | 1 / A1 | Operations owner |
| A07 Knowledge maintainer | AG-06, AG-08 | 1 / A1 | Knowledge owner |
| A08 Collection assistant | AG-10, AG-15 | 2 / A1 | Accounts owner |
| A09 Reconciliation assistant | AG-15 | 2 / A1 | Accounts reconciliation owner |
| A10 Renewal and retention assistant | AG-07, AG-16 | 2 / A1 | Customer success owner |
| A11 Sales proposal assistant | AG-02, AG-07 | 2 / A1 | Commercial owner |
| A12 Marketing assistant | AG-08, AG-10 | 2 / A1 | Marketing owner |
| A13 SEO accessibility and localization reviewer | AG-05, AG-08, AG-09 | 2 / A1 | Web quality owner |
| A14 Newsroom and official-channel assistant | AG-08, AG-10 | 3 / A1 | Communications owner |
| A15 BI analyst | AG-15, AG-22 | 1 / A1 | MIS/BI owner |
| A16 Market and regulatory watcher | AG-11, AG-18 | 3 / A1 | Strategy/compliance owner |
| A17 Integration and data-quality monitor | AG-05, AG-12, AG-18 | 2 / A0 | Integration owner |
| A18 Service-health and security triage | AG-12, AG-13, AG-14 | 3 / A0 | SRE/security owner |
| A19 Capacity and FinOps planner | AG-03, AG-15 | 3 / A1 | Infrastructure/finance owner |
| A20 Administration assistant | AG-04, AG-08 | 2 / A1 | CMS/platform owner |

AI-Y01 Preserve the role portfolios and establish a source crosswalk. Do not merge DOL A01–A20 IDs into DUDOS AG-01–22 or equate the DOL 6/10/4 AI waves with whole-project phases. Configure specializations with explicit scopes and an accountable owner/deputy. This crosswalk maps purpose, not granted execution rights.

AI-Y02 Separate logical agent work from deterministic business authority. The workflow coordinator selects bounded specialist tasks. A separate policy engine validates every proposed tool action against actor, tenant, object, field, current state, action, amount, recipient, scope, expiry and policy. Finance, entitlements, identities and acceptance remain deterministic/source-owned.

AI-Y03 Persist resumable runs and side-effect receipts. Store run/step/attempt IDs, event/correlation/causation, source versions, state version, checkpoint, lease, tool intent, idempotency/effect key and provider receipt. Resume from the last verified checkpoint after failure. Unknown provider outcome enters reconciliation; do not blindly repeat charge, renewal, provisioning or message sends.

AI-Y04 Require typed, permission-minimized inter-agent handoffs. Pass only task scope, authorized evidence references, structured extracted facts, proposed output type, remaining budget, deadline, reason and permitted next actions. Receiving agent reauthorizes source references and verifies a schema. It cannot inherit a sender’s wider rights or raw unrestricted conversation. Handoff acceptance and escalation remain auditable.

AI-Y05 Apply action-specific autonomy without repeated unnecessary prompts. Retain DOL A0 observe, A1 draft/recommend, A2 bounded reversible execution under valid policy, A3 consequential action preparation with required human decision. Drafts/read-only work and already delegated low-risk actions proceed within policy; pause only the affected action when authority, evidence, budget, risk or user intent is missing/changed. Do not treat an autonomy number or a model confidence score as permission.

AI-Y06 Protect knowledge, memory and evidence at each boundary. Filter before retrieval, recheck before output/handoff, bind caches to tenant/principal/policy/source version, invalidate on revocation and deletion, retain citations/freshness. Keep employee location, HR reasons and financial details out of public indexes and marketing contexts. Separate task state from user memory and verified business records.

AI-Y07 Version every model, tool and provider capability. Record exact provider API/model, supported SDK/protocol version, source URL/check date, tool schema/manifest digest, data terms/region, scopes, eligibility, costs, support window and fallback. Test changed models and tool manifests against the same corpus before adoption. Never auto-expand scopes or silently switch to an unapproved data processor.

AI-Y08 Address verified deprecations before selecting implementation products. Official OpenAI documentation reviewed on 15 September 2026 schedules Agent Builder shutdown for 30 November 2026; Evals becomes read-only 31 October and shuts down 30 November. No DUDOS dependency was verified. Avoid a new dependency without a supported migration plan; keep orchestration state, test cases and results portable.

AI-Y09 Measure verified benefit and cost with useful denominators. Report eligible cases, attempted cases, source-verified successes, human touch, corrections, escalations, latency and cost. Net time benefit equals validated saved minutes less review/exception/maintenance minutes. Net financial benefit subtracts model/tool/infrastructure and attributable human costs. No revenue inference from page views and no claimed automation percentage without a denominator.

AI-Y10 Introduce explicit offline and shadow evaluation before execution. Use bilingual task datasets and adversarial/negative cases; test policy denial, stale knowledge, failed handoff, incorrect prices, duplicate effects, budget exhaustion and fallback. Run source-backed observation/drafts first; compare with authorized reviewers before granting any narrow execution action. Critical control failures block only the affected capability and dependent release scope.

AI-Y11 Operate connector and provider currency monitoring as a proposal queue. Keep official feeds, installed-version exposure, material-difference evidence, effective/end-of-life dates, affected customers, owner/deputy, triage deadline, test and rollback plan. A missed watcher heartbeat has independent monitoring. Monthly business review evaluates useful proposals; urgent security/provider changes follow their severity deadline. This design does not create a live schedule.

AI-Y12 Show actual state and controlled recovery in the administration UI. Display inactive, draft-only, shadow, approved-limited, running, waiting, partial, failed, stopped and completed states with evidence/as-of time. Allow scoped pause/revoke and owned retry/reconcile. Bind approval to exact action/version and recheck current authority immediately before execution. Separate approved specification, deployed code, connected provider, tested behavior and active operation.

AI-Y13 Complete the recovered DOL companion contracts without replacing their identity. Retain the exact nine autonomy mappings, 41 proposed MCP tool entries, eight proposed OpenAPI paths, work-verification event schema and twenty rows in each of agent registers 07/21. The 41 tools have no inputSchema/outputSchema definitions; add versioned typed overlays and route bindings. Resolve the public A01 experience against knowledge.search and case.create_draft scoped-user tool metadata by defining public-safe retrieval/draft handling or requiring authentication for protected data; never silently widen the shared tools. Review actual effects of channel.check and integration.health_read, currently classified as draft/recommend. Preserve their source metadata and record any accepted correction in an overlay.

The preferred design uses a durable coordinator, independent policy enforcement, scoped data retrieval, selected specialists and a governed API/MCP gateway. Persist intent before an effect and receipts afterward. Unknown provider outcomes enter reconciliation. Transfer typed authorized references between agents, not broader rights. Logical roles can share a runtime while retaining separate permissions, budgets and tests.

## Universal website observations

D31-WEB-001 Correct source retention; replace generic application overlay. Adopt the new per-record proposed design binding as the working DUDOS crosswalk. Preserve exact source records. Pre-populate only supported platform-design values; customer values, named owners and observed outcomes remain separate.

D31-WEB-002 Use full source and mandatory companion routing. Run the DUDOS website prompt with the entire MPT-WEB source, exact JSON, applicability bindings and source provenance. Explicitly list MPT-ARC/REQ/SEC/API/SEO/ACC/CRM/DAT/OPS/LGL-001 and their triggers. Resolve governing versions and body availability through the source manifest; source titles alone do not execute them.

D31-WEB-003 Record Static/Dynamic/Hybrid comparison. Propose hybrid delivery: indexable public product/service/editorial pages and dynamic tenant operations. Compare static-only, dynamic-only and hybrid against identity, workflow, indexability, change frequency, operations, cost and migration. Defer final rendering/stack choice to runtime evidence and DAD.

D31-WEB-004 Complete routes and experience layers. Add or explicitly route/justify /products, /services, /developers, /developers/mcp, /search, /contact, /company, /careers, /accessibility and demo/trial; add signup/invite/recovery/security/sessions/context-switch/export/delete/suspension flows. Instantiate admin studio, newsletters, channels, campaigns, integrations, agents, compliance, releases and claims. Routes are proposed, not deployed.

D31-WEB-005 Populate field, workflow and metric contracts. Use entity-field bindings as design targets. For each scoped field add exact key, type, validation, required condition, sensitivity, source writer, storage/API, locale, retention and test. Define transition guards and metric formulas/denominators separately. Backend-derived tenant/grant context is never user-entered authority.

D31-WEB-006 Instantiate organization and authorization coverage. Create risk-based access cases for public, customer, merchant, staff, finance, partner, Academy, tenant admin, platform support, executive and machine actors. Use customer-group grants without cross-customer super-rights; exact destination authorization, revocation and recovery apply. Named owner assignments remain unassigned until recorded.

D31-WEB-007 Bind shared field authority and DOL capabilities. One shared versioned contract per integration identifies field writer, command authority, canonical/native IDs, provider capabilities, source freshness, replay/idempotency, corrections/deletions and reconciliation. DOL operational details adapt through its provider/tenant record; a DOL service listing is not proof of API support.

D31-WEB-008 Make agentic AI a bounded operating portfolio. Separate public answer, customer personal assistant, staff copilot, privileged admin agent and machine service accounts. Each agent records goal, trigger, plan, knowledge scope, tools, memory, model/prompt/version, execution authority, budgets, checkpoints, failure/handoff, evaluation, trace, kill/revoke and owner/deputy. Numeric autonomy aliases do not confer rights.

D31-WEB-009 Preserve governance of no-code edits and paid upgrades. Specify named configuration editors and engineering-only actions. Enforce exact diff, role/tenant/locale preview, concurrency, validation, maker/checker, effective date, release, monitoring and data-consistent recovery. New scopes need review; deploying an add-on never bills or entitles it automatically.

D31-WEB-010 Use one versioned catalog for every sales and AI surface. Catalog each product, service, solution, package, consultancy, training, event, marketplace listing and support offer using ID/type, source provider, audience/problem/value, capabilities, prerequisite/eligibility, region/locale, quote/price logic, rights, maturity, evidence, owner, SLA, CTA, validity and version. Reuse across page/search/AI/quote/CRM/campaign.

D31-WEB-011 Complete editorial, official-channel and campaign records. Instantiate separate editorial source, newsletter edition, official account and campaign preflight records. Editions retain dedupe/selection reason/rights, all cadences, localization, approval, consent, archive and correction. Official labels require evidence. Campaign execution, audience expansion, conversions and budget changes need separately scoped authority.

D31-WEB-012 Protect analytics truth and customer segmentation. Bind every event to actual business effect, consent state, identity scope, currency/timezone, bot/demo exclusion, dedupe and source-of-record. Segment only with lawful observed/declared data; unknown/suppressed demographic values remain such. Separate pipeline, booked revenue, settled cash and contribution; forecasting exposes assumptions.

D31-WEB-013 Conditional sector, people and quality overlays. Use explicit per-module applicability for Academy/student, alumni, guardian/proxy, HR, finance, healthcare, community and field visits. MQA is an applicable quality-assurance overlay, not a universal jurisdiction/accreditation statement. Preserve private notes, confidential cases, human correction and non-AI emergency route.

D31-WEB-014 Keep implementation, public claim and release state distinct. Every feature shows requirement, implementation, verification and approval independently. Package/docs are actual; proposed schemas, routes, APIs and tests are design artifacts. Application repo/history/live database/real AI/provider connectivity remain unavailable unless separately verified. Claim expiry suppresses stale public/AI statements.

D31-WEB-015 Separate source fidelity, mapping review and runtime testing. Report source-preservation checks as Verified; record proposed mapping review separately; all WEB-T001–030 and D31-WEB-AT001–018 runtime executions remain Not tested. Each gate identifies version/environment, test/evidence, verifier, date and applicable approval.

D31-WEB-016 Complete pilot, handover and continuity decisions. Choose one bounded DUDOS customer lifecycle; document actual repository, service/provider readiness, primary/deputy, budget, pilot cohort, baseline, acceptance, hypercare and export/restore. Bind source ZIP hashes and current commit when actual application exists. Reuse sanitized configuration only.

## Field and language readiness

The recovered DOL dictionary has 282 proposed fields. Preserve the exact field IDs, source labels and source constraints; use the new DUDOS field overlay for reusable-core or conditional-adapter treatment. The source leaves 193 Bangla labels UNKNOWN, and the remaining labels are not proof of human translation approval. Draft Bangla completion and typed validation are supplied separately. A draft translation is not approved public copy.

The source assigns max_length 255 to 277 fields and 2000 to five text fields; all 76 non-string fields carry the generic 255 value. AI-PUB-01 HTTP authorization uses resource-bound access tokens; the server validates its audience on every request. Invalid/expired tokens and insufficient scopes fail authorization. AI-PUB-02 Reject token passthrough and unauthorized resource access; validate URL destinations and redirect hops against SSRF. AI-PUB-03 The official extension supports application identities for background and server-to-server work without an interactive user present. AI-PUB-04 OpenAI documents handoffs when a specialist owns the next conversational branch and agents-as-tools when a manager retains responsibility. AI-PUB-07 Untrusted content can attempt prompt injection and data exfiltration. Structured node outputs, constrained tools and isolated data flows reduce risk but do not remove it. Treat schema validation as one layer alongside deterministic authorization. [OpenAI: Safety in building agents](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agent-builder-safety)
